title: Thargoid Swarm
tagline: Hold the line in a Cobra against wave after wave of Thargoid drones, Scouts and Interceptors.
description: A swarm drops out of witch space in formation and peels off to dive at you. Every third wave an Interceptor arrives: break its hearts one by one. Pick up weapon upgrades, shield cells and rebuys from the wreckage, and see what combat rank your run earns.
